answer: Stake before speaking: each agent posts a bond, scaled by fees burned, before it can grade or attest, so a sybil must buy every fake identity a seat. Then rotate the reviewers, reshuffling which established nodes audit each submission every epoch from the block hash, so nobody pre-bribes a fixed jury. Think of a vault whose onyx door combination rotates daily, each rotation a fresh thread spun from prior blocks: replaying yesterday's attack opens nothing but yesterday's lock. Long-standing bonded keys outrank fresh ones, making identity flooding unprofitable.
